OlinkViz ggplot2 theme

Source: R/utils.R
theme_olinkviz.Rd

A clean, publication-ready ggplot2 theme for OlinkViz plots. Builds on `theme_bw()` with minimal gridlines and consistent typography.

Usage

theme_olinkviz(
  base_size = .ov_base(),
  base_family = "sans",
  axes = getOption("olinkviz.axes", "box")
)

Arguments

base_size

Base font size in points. Defaults to `getOption("olinkviz.base_size", 11)`.

base_family

Base font family (default "sans").

axes

`"box"` (default; full panel frame) or `"l"` (left and bottom axis lines only). Defaults to `getOption("olinkviz.axes", "box")`.

Value

A ggplot2 theme object.

Details

All `plot_*()` functions size their text and marks from the same base size, so a figure can be drawn at its final journal size. Set it once per session:

“` options(olinkviz.base_size = 7) # 7 pt body text for a 89 mm column options(olinkviz.axes = "l") # left and bottom axis lines, no frame “`

See also

Other themes: theme_editorial(), theme_journal(), theme_journal_text()

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point() + theme_olinkviz()

ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point() + theme_olinkviz(base_size = 7, axes = "l")
